title: Hoc tieng Anh tu nho nhung gap nguoi ban xu lai dung hinh
content: Ban hoc tieng Anh tu hoi tieu hoc, len cap 2, cap 3 roi vao dai hoc van tiep tuc hoc. Nhung khi gap nguoi ban xu hoi duong, ban bong dung hinh nhu may tinh bi treo.
scenes: Ban bat dau hoc tieng Anh tu hoi tieu hoc.
Len cap 2, tieng Anh van tiep tuc xuat hien trong thoi khoa bieu.
Cap 3 roi dai hoc, tieng Anh van la mon bat buoc.
Mot ngay, nguoi ban xu tien lai hoi duong bang tieng Anh.
Ban dung hinh nhu may tinh bi loi he dieu hanh.
